description: This file is a shell script that defines a suite of tests for Git's filter-branch command, specifically testing its behavior with commits containing null sha1 trees and entries, as well as its filtering capabilities.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified file changes, used to setup test scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail, used for negative test cases.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files, used for verifying test results.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
